property_summary: For all callers, only the admin (the deployer) can successfully call setOwner (call completes and returns true); the mutant that removes the admin check allows some non-admin caller to complete setOwner, violating this rule.
change_summary: Modify onlyAdmin modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so setOwner executes for non-admins and returns true as before — this changes which callers can successfully call setOwner but keeps the same return value for admin; however when called by non-admins it will now complete and return true (different observable behavior for some callers).
